item.title: iPhone 18 Pro & Pro Max: Specs, Pricing & Impact
item.description: Apple unveils the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max with the new A20 Pro chip, longer battery life, new colors, and higher prices starting at $1,199.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro & Pro Max: AI Camera, A20 Pro & Siri AI
item.description: Apple’s fall “Surprise and Shine” event reveals the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, featuring a 48‑MP variable‑aperture camera, A20 Pro chip, vapor‑chamber cooling, and Siri AI on iOS 27.

item.title: iPhone Air 2 Expected Early 2027 with Five New Upgrades
item.description: Apple’s iPhone Air 2 will debut Q1 2027 with a second 48 MP camera, smaller Dynamic Island, A20 Pro 2 nm chip, upgraded N2 Wi‑Fi/BT and C2 5G modem.

item.title: iPad mini 2024: OLED, A20 Pro Chip & Major Leap
item.description: Apple’s next iPad mini, expected in October, may bring an OLED display, vibration speaker, water resistance and a jump to the A20 Pro processor.
